frontmatter.name: security-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Use after any change touching authentication, RLS/service-role data access, Supabase migrations or RPCs, admin routes (src/routes/admin, src/routes/api/internal/admin, supabase/functions/admin), comment moderation, or secret/env handling — reviews for auth bypass, RLS bypass, and input-validation gaps distinct from API-convention or UI-consistency concerns.
